scope: Official economic datasets considered for a separately structured corpus expansion. No bulk download is authorized by this plan.
ranking_method: Ranked qualitatively by economic usefulness, potential volume, official provenance, access reliability, licensing clarity, and implementation cost. Unverified size and licensing details are marked for review rather than inferred.

candidates.license_terms: World Bank says CC BY 4.0 is the default for datasets it produces and distributes as open data; dataset catalog labels may specify other licenses. Confirm each dataset's license metadata before broad collection; include attribution and do not imply World Bank endorsement.
candidates.format: Indicators API JSON/XML; DataBank downloads include CSV/Excel/ZIP options
candidates.approximate_size: The 2020-2022 USA/India GDP preflight was 1,426 bytes over two pages; full WDI bulk size not verified and may be large.
candidates.update_frequency: Indicator-specific; API reports a dataset last-updated date. Verify before each acquisition.
candidates.geographic_coverage: Global economies, multiple indicators, annual and some higher-frequency series
candidates.download_method: Documented Indicators API for bounded queries; official DataBank bulk export only after archive size and scope are validated.
candidates.access_status: Documented API tested with USA and India over 2020-2022 for GDP: 6 observations across 2 pages, all country-year keys unique, no missing values. Metadata retrieved for all 7 proposed indicators. No expansion records were acquired; batch is on hold.
review_items: World Bank states CC BY 4.0 is the default for World Bank-produced open datasets, but dataset catalog entries may use ODbL, external/custom terms, or restricted microdata licenses.

Indicator metadata cites upstream national agencies, OECD, IMF, ILO, UN, and Eurostat; their rights are not exposed by the Indicators API. Obtain manual confirmation that WDI licensing covers the cited inputs before batch acquisition or redistribution.
The API unit field is empty for all 7 indicators in metadata; preserve it verbatim and also retain indicator names/source notes as semantic measurement descriptions.
Attribution must credit the World Bank, link CC BY 4.0, identify changes, avoid implying endorsement, and preserve indicator-level upstream sourceOrganization provenance.
